speech.heard: In Iceland, 100% of adults have a bank or mobile account. In South Sudan, 6%. USA has 97% of adults with a bank or mobile account. India has 89%, while Brazil has 86%. Nigeria has 63% of adults with an account. In Pakistan, 27% of adults have an account. South Sudan has 6%, the world's lowest, leaving most people completely unbanked. Where does your country land?
